properties.description: Shelter with two glass windows and the front can be closed with a curtain. Bug fireplace and BBQ in the center. Firewood, saw and other utilities available. Can be reached via a board walk starting after the radio building.

properties.name: Gapahuken på Hundbergan
properties.description: En gapahuk som ble ferdigbygget i 2022 og meningen med den er at folk kan ta seg en tur og siden plassen har en bålpanne som de som har lyst kan lage seg grillmat. Gapahuken har utsikt mot Sjøvegan sentrum.
07/23: Small hut with table and 6 chairs. The door is removed from the free.

properties.name: viewpoint shelter
properties.description: Small hut with a big window facing the sea. Viewpoint for the sunset. Overnight sleeping is not allowed.

properties.name: Varmebua på Kjølen
properties.description: Small shelter with (electric) heating and electricity on the summit. In an emergency about 5 people can sleep here.

properties.name: Ovi Raishiin - Nordkalottstua
properties.description: DNT standard key during summer season, otherwise upon reservation
